purpose: A developer asks Claude Code a question about data in one or more SQL Server databases and receives a defensible answer: what was checked, which queries ran, what evidence supports the conclusion, what remains uncertain, and where the data came from. Investigation should feel conversational, iterative, and fast, without sacrificing control of database access.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.BoundedExecution
requirements.text: Every query runs within configured timeout, row, byte, concurrency and per-investigation query budgets, can be cancelled, and reports when its result was truncated.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.EvidenceProvenance
requirements.text: Every executed query carries a query id, the exact SQL, the connection alias and timestamps; investigations persist questions, hypotheses, findings and uncertainty without raw result rows by default.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.LocalOnlyProvisioning
requirements.text: Connections and their credentials are provisioned only through a local interactive command run by the developer; no MCP operation accepts or returns a credential.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.NoSecretDisclosure
requirements.text: Credentials and connection secrets never appear in MCP output, diagnostics, investigation history or the knowledge store.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.ReadOnly
requirements.text: Only bounded, authorized read-only SQL queries may execute. The gateway accepts exactly one bounded SELECT per request, referencing only objects and columns within the alias's approved scope, through a fail-closed allowlist, and a dedicated read-only SQL principal denies writes independently of that validation.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.ReviewedRelationships
requirements.text: Inferred cross-database relationships stay proposed, with provenance, until explicitly reviewed; rejected relationships and their evidence are retained and never promoted.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.SafeFailure
requirements.text: SQL errors, cancellation, schema drift and unreachable databases produce actionable, sanitized errors and never fabricated results.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.SchemaFreshness
requirements.text: Schema snapshots record their source and capture time and are refreshed when drift is detected.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.SeparatePerDatabaseQueries
requirements.text: Each query targets exactly one connection alias. Cross-database correlation happens on the agent side over separate bounded results, never in cross-database or linked-server SQL.

requirements.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.InvestigateData.SoleConversationalHost
requirements.text: Claude Code is the only conversational interface. The server speaks MCP over stdio, keeps stdout for protocol messages only, and offers no other chat, web or model surface.

policies.name: ::SQLInvestigator.Investigation.ProductionDataApproval
policies.statement: No production data reaches Claude Code until the data owner has approved the specific data classifications and environment.
